SELECT HDT.DESCRIPTION DOCUMENT_TYPE_DESC, CON.* FROM ( SELECT CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.DOCUMENT_TYPE, CC.BUSINESS_TYPE, CC.TENANT_ID AS BP_ID, HBM.BP_NAME, 'CON_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, nvl( ( SELECT MAX(CCC.TIMES) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID GROUP BY CCC.CONTRACT_ID ),0) AS ALL_TIMES, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 9 ) AS OVERDUE_TIMES, nvl( ( SELECT MAX(CCC.FINE_DAYS) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 1 AND CCC.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY CCC.CONTRACT_ID ),0) AS OVERDUE_DAYS, nvl( ( SELECT SUM(CCC.DUE_AMOUNT-CCC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 1 AND CCC.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' AND CCC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG != 'FULL' GROUP BY CCC.CONTRACT_ID),0) AS OVERDUE_AMOUNT, nvl( ( SELECT SUM(CCC.DUE_AMOUNT-CCC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 9 GROUP BY CCC.CONTRACT_ID),0) AS OVERDUE_PENALTY, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 1 AND CCC.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' AND CCC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG != 'FULL' ) AS IS_SETTLE FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=CC.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON CC.TENANT_ID = HBM.BP_ID WHERE CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND (CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' OR (CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT CT WHERE CT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND CT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND CT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=CC.CONTRACT_ID ) >0 ) ) AND CC.COMPANY_ID = #{request.companyId} UNION ALL SELECT FCT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_NAME, FCT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_ID, FCT.DOCUMENT_TYPE, FCT.BUSINESS_TYPE, HBM.BP_ID, HBM.BP_NAME, 'FCT_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, nvl( ( SELECT MAX(FQC.TIMES) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID GROUP BY FCT.CONTRACT_ID ), 0 ) AS ALL_TIMES, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM = 45 ) AS OVERDUE_TIMES, nvl( ( SELECT MAX(FQC.FINE_DAYS) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM IN(54, 55, 57, 51) AND FQC.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY FQC.CONTRACT_ID ), 0 ) AS OVERDUE_DAYS, nvl( ( SELECT SUM(FQC.DUE_AMOUNT-nvl(FQC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0)) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM IN (54, 55, 57, 51) AND FQC.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' AND FQC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG != 'FULL' GROUP BY FQC.CONTRACT_ID ), 0 ) AS OVERDUE_AMOUNT, nvl( ( SELECT SUM(FQC.DUE_AMOUNT-nvl(FQC.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0)) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM = 45 GROUP BY FQC.CONTRACT_ID ), 0 ) AS OVERDUE_PENALTY, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM IN (54, 55, 57, 51) AND FQC.OVERDUE_STATUS = 'Y' AND FQC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG != 'FULL' ) AS IS_SETTLE FROM FCT_CONTRACT FCT, FCT_PROJECT_BP FPB, HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE FCT.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND (FCT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' OR (FCT.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_CONTRACT FT WHERE FT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND FT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND FT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=FCT.CONTRACT_ID ) >0 ) ) AND FCT.PROJECT_ID = FPB.PROJECT_ID AND FPB.BP_ID = HBM.BP_ID AND FPB.CREDIT_GRANTOR_PARTY='Y' AND FCT.COMPANY_ID = #{request.companyId} ) CON LEFT JOIN HLS_DOCUMENT_TYPE HDT ON HDT.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY=CON.CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY AND HDT.DOCUMENT_TYPE=CON.DOCUMENT_TYPE AND HDT.BUSINESS_TYPE=CON.BUSINESS_TYPE WHERE 1=1
AND CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
AND CON.CONTRACT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{contractName}),'%')
AND CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{approvalNumber}),'%')
AND CON.BP_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')

SELECT PRCR.COLLECTION_RULE_ID, PRCR.COLLECTION_DAYS, PRCR.DESCRIPTION, PRCR.ENABLED_FLAG, PRCR.LAST_COLLECTION_DATE, CON.* FROM PLM_RENT_COLLECTION_RULE PRCR JOIN ( SELECT CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.COMPANY_ID, FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID, PP.PROJECT_ASSISTANT_ASSIGNS_ID, 'CON_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, ( SELECT MIN(CCC.DUE_DATE) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID
AND CCC.OVERDUE_STATUS='Y' AND CCC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG!='FULL' ) OVERDUE_DATE, ( SELECT MAX (CCC.FINE_DAYS) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID
AND CCC.OVERDUE_STATUS='Y' AND CCC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG!='FULL' ) OVERDUE_DAYS, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 9 ) AS OVERDUE_TIMES FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=CC.PROJECT_ID JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID=PP.EMPLOYEE_ID AND FEA.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' WHERE CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT FCT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_NAME, FCT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_ID, FCT.COMPANY_ID, FP.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID, FP.PROJECT_ASSISTANT_ASSIGNS_ID, 'FCT_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, ( SELECT MIN(FQC.DUE_DATE) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID
AND FQC.OVERDUE_STATUS='Y' AND FQC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG!='FULL' ) OVERDUE_DATE, ( SELECT MAX(FQC.FINE_DAYS) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID
AND FQC.OVERDUE_STATUS='Y' AND FQC.WRITE_OFF_FLAG!='FULL' ) OVERDUE_DAYS, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM = 45 ) AS OVERDUE_TIMES FROM FCT_CONTRACT FCT JOIN FCT_PROJECT FP ON FCT.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID WHERE FCT.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' ) CON ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=PRCR.CONTRACT_ID AND CON.CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY=PRCR.CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY WHERE PRCR.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' AND CON.OVERDUE_TIMES >0 AND PRCR.COLLECTION_DAYS IS NOT NULL

SELECT CON.* FROM ( SELECT CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.COMPANY_ID, 'CON_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, ( SELECT MIN(CCC.DUE_DATE) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 9 ) OVERDUE_DATE, nvl( ( SELECT MAX(CCC.FINE_DAYS) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 9 ),0) AS COLLECTION_DAYS FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=CC.PROJECT_ID WHERE CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' UNION ALL SELECT FCT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_NAME, FCT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_ID, FCT.COMPANY_ID, 'FCT_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, ( SELECT MAX(FQC.DUE_DATE) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM = 45 ) OVERDUE_DATE, nvl( ( SELECT MAX(FQC.FINE_DAYS) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM = 45 ),0) AS COLLECTION_DAYS FROM FCT_CONTRACT FCT WHERE FCT.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND FCT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' )CON WHERE CON.FINE_DAYS >30

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.COMPANY_ID, 'CON_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC WHERE CCC.CONTRACT_ID = CC.CONTRACT_ID AND CCC.CF_ITEM = 9 ) AS OVERDUE_TIMES FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=CC.PROJECT_ID WHERE CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND ( CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' OR ( CC.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT CT WHERE CT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND CT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND CT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=CC.CONTRACT_ID ) >0 ) ) AND CC.CONTRACT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT R.CONTRACT_ID FROM PLM_RENT_COLLECTION_RULE R WHERE R.CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY='CON_CONTRACT' AND R.ENABLED_FLAG='Y') UNION ALL SELECT FCT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_NAME, FCT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, FCT.CONTRACT_ID, FCT.COMPANY_ID, 'FCT_CONTRACT' AS CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW FQC WHERE FQC.CONTRACT_ID = FCT.CONTRACT_ID AND FQC.CF_ITEM = 45 ) AS OVERDUE_TIMES FROM FCT_CONTRACT FCT WHERE FCT.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND ( FCT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' OR ( FCT.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_CONTRACT FT WHERE FT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND FT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND FT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=FCT.CONTRACT_ID ) >0 ) ) AND FCT.CONTRACT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT R.CONTRACT_ID FROM PLM_RENT_COLLECTION_RULE R WHERE R.CONTRACT_DOC_CATEGORY='FCT_CONTRACT' AND R.ENABLED_FLAG='Y')) CON WHERE CON.OVERDUE_TIMES>0
